reuse.why: Follows the existing ensureAccountIsNotLinked guard pattern with a sibling guard; it does not fold the new precondition into a single shared link-precondition step, so each handler gains another call.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once; only a one-line call is repeated in each of the six provider link functions, mirroring the tree's existing per-provider structure.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts next to ensureAccountIsNotLinked and runs before any side effect in every link handler.

scope.why: Only the new guard, its six call sites and a focused test are added.

maintainability.why: Clear, single-purpose guard; the remaining risk is that a new provider must remember to call two guards, which a combined precondition helper would avoid.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; every link*Account handler calls the new guard

one_place.where: ensureAccountIsOpenForLinking in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by all six link handlers (goCardless, simpleFin, pluggyai, akahu, enableBanking, fintegra)
